renders._yaml:
- component: card
  id: adaptor_ranges
  title: Ranges flagged as adaptor or vector
  description: |-
    The hero number is the count of ranges FCS-adaptor flags as adaptor or vector sequence, with the number of distinct sequences they sit on, and the bar splits them by the action it recommends. It answers how much of the assembly carries leftover adaptors.
    How to read: TRIM removes an adaptor at a sequence end and EXCLUDE drops a whole sequence. A clean assembly shows zero here, and the table still lists it as screened. Internal adaptor hits are not removed automatically, so review them.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/ncbi/fcs/FCS-adaptor-quickstart.md
  column: seq_id
  aggregation: count
  aggregations:
  - nunique
  secondary_layout: composition
  breakdown_col: action
  filter_expr: col('action') != 'none'
  caption: ranges, by recommended action
  headline: true

- component: table
  title: Adaptor and vector calls
  description: |-
    Each row is a range FCS-adaptor flags, with the action, the matching adaptor, the source type and the bases involved. An assembly with nothing flagged keeps one row with action none. It answers exactly which sequences to trim or exclude.
    How to read: filter by action to plan the cleaning, and read the adaptor name to trace which library kit left it.
